options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Completion Goal
options.doc:
A goal to reach.

1. Full Story Clear - Defeat Chimata Tenkyuu, Nitori Kawashiro, Takane Yamashiro.
2. Minimum Story Clear - Defeat Takane Yamashiro.
3. All Ability Cards Owned.
4. All Bosses Defeated - Challenge Market does not count.
5. Challenge Market Clear.
6. Clear everything except Challenge Market.
7. Clear everything.
8. Dragon Gem Hunt - Collect a certain number of Dragon Gem items randomly placed throughout the game.
options.doc_fr:
Un objectif à atteindre.

1. Toute l'histoire clair - Defeat Chimata Tenkyuu, Nitori Kawashiro, Takane Yamashiro.
2. Minimum histoire clair - Defeat Takane Yamashiro.
3. Toutes les cartes d'aptitude sont détenues.
4. Tous les Boss défait - Challenge Market ne compte pas.
5. Défi Marché clair.
6. Tout effacer sauf Challenge Market.
7. Dégagez tout.
8. Dragon Gem Hunt - Recueillir un certain nombre d'objets Dragon Gem placés au hasard tout au long du jeu.

options.doc: Percentage chance that any given filler Item will be replaced by a trap item.

Which Trap items will not be generated if Trap Chance is higher than 0.
Remove any of these entries if you want those traps to appear.

options.name: Temporary Trap Durations
options.doc:
How much time should any of the Temporary traps last (in seconds, max 900).
If not set, the game will assume default values as follows:

Extreme Speed Trap/"aya_speed" - 5 seconds
Magic Circle Disable Trap/"circle_disable" - 15 seconds
Freeze Trap/"freeze" - 3 seconds
Powerless Shot Trap/"powerless" - 6 seconds
options.doc_fr:
Combien de temps doit durer l'un des pièges temporaires (en secondes, max 900).
Si le jeu n'est pas défini, les valeurs par défaut seront les suivantes :

Trap à vitesse extrême/"aya speed" - 5 secondes
Magic Circle Disable Trap/"circle disable" - 15 secondes
Gel Trap/"gel" - 3 secondes
Piège de tir sans puissance/"sans puissance" - 6 secondes

options.name: Include Non-Money Filler
options.doc:
Whether filler items that are not Funds or Bullet Money will appear during generation.
Also affects Traps.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Death Link Trigger
options.doc:
Determines when a Death Link would be sent. Only takes effect if Death Link is enabled.
Can be temporarily changed during gameplay.

0. Upon losing a life. This means Life Explosion Elixir will also trigger Death Link.
1. Upon failing a stage attempt. All lives must be lost before this triggers.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine quand un lien de mort serait envoyé. Ne prend effet que si Death Link est activé.
Peut être temporairement changé pendant le gameplay.

0. En perdant une vie. Cela signifie que Life Explosion Elixir déclenchera également Death Link.
1. Après avoir échoué à une tentative d'étape. Toutes les vies doivent être perdues avant que cela ne se déclenche.

options.name: Anti-Death Link Invincibility
options.doc: Determines whether invincibility can protect against incoming Death Links.
options.doc_fr: Déterminer si l'invincibilité peut protéger contre les liens de mort entrants.

options.name: Energy Link
options.doc:
Allows usage of the EnergyLink pool.
Funds can be deposited and withdrawn at a certain exchange rate.
However, undeposited and withdrawn Funds will not be automatically saved.
options.doc_fr:
Permet l'utilisation du pool EnergyLink.
Les fonds peuvent être déposés et retirés à un certain taux de change.
Toutefois, les fonds non déposés et retirés ne seront pas automatiquement sauvegardés.

options.name: Energy Link Bullet Money Exchanges
options.doc:
If enabled, EnergyLink exchanges permit exchanging energy for Bullet Money as well.
Conversion rates for Bullet Money differ from that for Funds.
Bullet Money cannot be deposited nor withdrawn outside of stages.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les échanges EnergyLink permettent également l'échange d'énergie contre Bullet Money.
Les taux de conversion pour Bullet Money diffèrent de ceux des Fonds.
Bullet Money ne peut être déposé ni retiré en dehors des étapes.

options.name: Starting Market
options.doc:
Choose which stage to have unlocked at the start of the game.

If Progressive Markets is enabled:
- Unlock items for stages preceding the Starting Market will not appear.
- Any stages preceding the Starting Market will be unlocked.

choices.label: End of Market - Lunar Rainbow Market

options.doc_fr:
Choisissez l'étape à débloquer au début du jeu.

Si Marchés Progressifs est activé:
- Déverrouiller les éléments pour les étapes précédant le marché de départ n'apparaîtra pas.
- Toutes les étapes précédant le marché de départ seront déverrouillées.

options.name: Itemize Equipment Upgrades
options.doc:
Whether starting card slots and equip cost will be upgraded according to the number of bosses defeated or via items received.
The game begins with 1 starting card slot and 100% equip cost.

1. Disabled - Slots and cost will be unlocked according to the number of bosses defeated (vanilla).
2. Simultaneous - Both slots and cost will be upgraded at the same time.
3. Separate - Slots and cost will only be upgraded with the appropriate items received.

options.name: Simultaneous - Equipment Upgrades Count
options.doc:
Only used if "Itemize Equipment Upgrades" is set to Simultaneous.
This will determine how many of them will be in the item pool.
Minimum of +6 items because of one of the Achievements.
Can technically go up to +33, but it is recommended to only go up to +15 at most.

options.name: Separate - Starting Card Slot Upgrades Count
options.doc:
Only used if "Itemize Equipment Upgrades" is set to Separate.
This determines how many starting card slot upgrades will be in the item pool.
Minimum of +6 slots because of one of the Achievements.
Can technically go up to +33, but it is recommended to only go up to +15 at most.

options.name: Separate - Equip Cost Upgrades Count
options.doc:
Only used if "Itemize Equipment Upgrades" is set to Separate.
This will determine how many equip cost upgrades will be in the item pool.
Equip cost maxes out at +900%, and each upgrade is worth 50%.

options.name: Anti-Grinding Item Toggle
options.doc: Toggles whether generation logic should consider anti-grinding placements.

options.name: Anti-Grinding Item Placements
options.doc:
Which items should be prioritized for placement during early game to reduce grinding as much as possible.
Four cards and 1000 Funds are on the list by default, but you can choose to remove them.

options.name: Allow Permanent Player Upgrades
options.doc:
Whether items for permanently upgrading player initial stats (starting lives, starting shot attack, etc.) will appear.
These permanent upgrades were never part of the original game, and will not be required for progression.
However, they will be prioritized for filler before other filler items can be placed (e.g. Funds filler, one-time Shot Attack bonuses).

options.name: Starting Upgrades: Lives
options.doc:
How many upgrades for additional starting lives? Cannot exceed 3 upgrades (4 starting lives).
Note that you begin with 1 life by default in every stage.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de mises à niveau pour des vies de départ supplémentaires? Ne peut pas dépasser 3 mises à jour (4 vies de départ).
Notez que vous commencez par 1 vie par défaut à chaque étape.

options.name: Starting Upgrades: Bullet Money (70 Bullet Money/upgrade)
options.doc:
How many upgrades for additional starting Bullet Money? Each upgrade is worth 70 Bullet Money.
Note that you begin with 0 Bullet Money by default in every stage.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de mises à jour pour le démarrage supplémentaire Bullet Money? Chaque mise à jour vaut 70 dollars.
Notez que vous commencez par 0 Bullet Money par défaut à chaque étape.

options.name: Starting Upgrades: Power
options.doc:
How many upgrades for additional starting Power? Cannot exceed 3 upgrades (4 starting Power).
Note that you begin with 1 Power by default in every stage.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de mises à niveau pour une puissance de démarrage supplémentaire? Ne peut pas dépasser 3 mises à jour (4 puissance de départ).
Notez que vous commencez par 1 Puissance par défaut à chaque étape.

options.name: Starting Upgrades: Shot Attack (5%/upgrade)
options.doc:
How many upgrades for additional starting shot attack? Each upgrade is worth 5%.
Note that you begin with 100% shot attack by default in every stage.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de mises à jour pour une attaque de tir supplémentaire? Chaque mise à niveau vaut 5%.
Notez que vous commencez par une attaque à 100% par défaut à chaque étape.

options.name: Starting Upgrades: Magic Circle Attack (5%/upgrade)
options.doc:
How many upgrades for additional starting magic circle strength? Each upgrade is worth 5%.
Note that you begin with 100% magic circle strength by default in every stage.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de mises à jour pour la force supplémentaire du cercle magique de départ? Chaque mise à niveau vaut 5%.
Notez que vous commencez par 100% de force de cercle magique par défaut dans chaque étape.

options.name: Lock Challenge Market in Logic
options.doc:
Generation logic will consider Challenge Market inaccessible if all other stages have not been unlocked yet.
Disable this option to turn off the above handicap.
options.doc_fr:
La logique de génération considérera Challenge Market inaccessible si toutes les autres étapes n'ont pas encore été déverrouillées.
Désactiver cette option pour désactiver le handicap ci-dessus.

options.name: Recommended Loadout in Logic
options.doc:
Whether the generation logic should include certain Ability Cards as compulsory before challenging late-game stages.

0. Disabled.
1. Stage 4 requires only 2 of them, stage 5 requires 4, etc.
2. All late-game stages logically require all cards below.

* 4th-6th Market + Challenge Market:
Life Explosion Elixir, Princess Kaguya's Secret Stash, Soot-covered Uchiwa,
Esteemed Authority, Gluttonous Centipede, and Money Is The Best Lawyer In Hell.
* End of Market:
Life Explosion Elixir, Esteemed Authority
* Takane: + Lucky Cat with Good Business Skills
* Nitori: + 1 card loadout slot progression

options.name: Recommended Equipment Upgrades in Logic
options.doc:
Whether generation logic should also consider placing itemized equipment upgrades before late-game stages.
This only works if "Itemize Equipment Upgrades" and "Recommended Loadout in Logic" are enabled.
This will scale based on "Recommended Loadout in Logic".

options.name: Dragon Gems Required
options.doc:
Only effective if the Completion Type is set to Dragon Gem Hunt.
This will determine how many Dragon Gem items are required for goal.
If there are not enough locations for the required count, the count will be adjusted accordingly.

options.name: Dragon Gems in Pool
options.doc:
Only effective if the Completion Type is set to Dragon Gem Hunt.
This will determine how many Dragon Gem items would be in the item pool.
If this number is less than the victory condition number,
the number in the item pool will be randomized with a minimum the same as the victory condition.
